integrity: The proof is analytic. The accompanying standalone finite checker tests ordinal-gap normalization and selected quantitative inequalities, but does not prove statements over all irrational frequencies.
scientific_limitations: The result concerns only Lebesgue-weighted consecutive ordinal patterns of irrational real rotations. The sharp log-partial-quotient block law has an O(log log a) remainder, not an identified bounded constant. An older equivalent result under another term cannot be ruled out by search.
title: A sharp partial-quotient law for the additive ordinal-entropy defect of rotations
